stories.headline: Nigeria's NDLEA catches South African courier with 36.65 kg of cocaine at Lagos airport and arrests a local car dealer
stories.summary: The woman was stopped on 7 October in the departure hall as she prepared to fly to South Africa via Doha, with the cocaine packed in two bags and masked with dried pepper.
